MapPlans._comment: in faction generator, the home faction itself is provided externally (mode own/district/existing). homeTemplateID is a registered factionInit used in mode own; mealHours/activeHours override the instantiated home.

characters._generatorID: either a character baseID or a generator template ID

roomGroups._comment: both siblings share the main bedroom (replaces old map_init_placeChara)

tempHomeFactions._comment: we will need this for when we create a family and want them to say live in hotel while preserving the family hierarchy -> in this case it will mean the family will have their home created but vacant. mainly for hospital patient etc.
tempHomeFactions._comment2: we use scope so we dont have to hardcode factionID and this will allow generator to automatically fill in slots in the world wherever that is.
tempHomeFactions._comment3: chance 0 placeholder: enable when authoring a specific temp-home scope. if forceSatisfySkillsReq is true, character is upgraded to satisfy skill req; if false, check actual skills.

workFactions._comment: list of scope filters to find a valid faction with valid membertypes. for example, day time/ night time job, what type of job (doctor/conveniencestore)

activityFactions._comment: subscribe to activities, for example gym membership
